validation.notes: Repaired the authorization-to-effect chain in three production modules: (1) packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts recoverToolInvocation now requires !cancelled && tool !== undefined && call.replay === 'safe' && tool.replay === 'safe', so a stored 'never' declaration, a tightened current declaration, or a missing tool implementation stays interrupted instead of crossing the effect boundary; (2) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/effect-gate.ts Gate.admit now performs the single synchronous state check (aborting -> AbortRequested(cancellation), closed -> closing error) before invoking, so cancellation/close prevents admission; (3) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/tools.ts executeToolCall now executes with call.args (the cleared/persisted arguments of ClearedToolCall) instead of call.toolCall.arguments, so safe replay and before_tool replacements reach the tool. The regression links the real effect-gate, execution/tools, runtime/drive/tools, runtime/progress and session/values modules in one createGraph realm with self-supplied boundary fakes (durable value store behind the Lane mutation line, hook registry, pi-ai argument validation, chord withAbortSignal, tool-placement helpers) and asserts admission refusal, cleared-argument propagation, checkpoint-cleared-before-invocation, recovery tool_start with persisted arguments, drain-before-publish ordering, persisted-argument replay for safe+safe, interruption for stored 'never' and for missing tools (checkpoint content/details preserved, no effect, no after_tool), cancelled control and aborting gate starting no effect, and durable outcome_ready settlement. Verified detection per file by restoring each source alone to its faulty baseline: effect-gate.ts fails with 'aborting gate executed the admitted effect', execution/tools.ts with 'executor used arguments other than the cleared ones', runtime/drive/tools.ts with 'an unauthorized interrupted call crossed the effect boundary' (uncaught node:assert/strict assertions, no import errors or crashes).
